text:
Anna: Heads-up — I'm scheduling a Terraform apply during tomorrow's change window (Mon 03/23 02:00–04:00 UTC). Two small items: 1) rotate service-account keys for analytics-collector and billing-worker; 2) change deploybot serial backoff from 10s -> 30s for subnet provisioning to reduce thundering herd. No DB or destructive changes. Need +1 from Network/SRE/Security before I run plan and request approval.

Ben: pinging @Infra-Oncall and @Security — any red flags on key rotation? Are we okay with 30s backoff for critical subnets?

Infra-Oncall: quick check — 30s seems fine, reduces retries. Ensure you don't bump the provider during the apply. Which provider version are you pinning?

Anna: pinning aws provider to 4.55.0 in the root module; added provider lockfile. Plan uploaded to internal Terraform UI. Will run plan in staging then do prod canary (eu-west-1) then full rollout.

Terraform-Bot: plan uploaded: https://terraform.redwood.internal/plans/plan-1723456789

Chris: skimming plan — SA key resources replaced (force_new_key). No route table or security group changes. Approve from my side. :thumbsup:

Security: please confirm rotation process for downstream services — do they support key rollover with a 5m overlap?

Anna: yes — we've added overlap and env var refresh; tested on staging for billing-worker. Logs: ```rotate-keys --service billing-worker --overlap 5m``` Ran at 2026-03-18 09:14 UTC, no failures.

DevBot: scheduled apply request queued. Waiting for human approval.

Ben: Approving to proceed with canary in eu-west-1. I'll be oncall during the window. If deploybot throttles too much we rollback to previous key with emergency path documented.

Anna: Great. I'll kick off staging plan tonight, then request prod apply approval in the channel before applying. Rollback plan summarized: 1) revert key change via `terraform apply -target=module.keys.old` 2) set deploybot backoff back to 10s 3) trigger smoke tests.

Infra-Oncall: Add a short playbook note to incidents repo and tag the run with release:rot-20260323.

Anna: Done. Link: https://internal.redwood/ops/playbooks/rotate-keys-2026

Security: ++ approved as long as audit logs are enabled and KMS usage is in the plan.

Terraform-Bot: apply locked to user Anna. Ready for approval.

Anna: Thanks all — will post plan output and exact apply command right before window. Will also add a deploybot circuit-breaker threshold in case errors spike.

Ben: I'll respond with :eyes: and monitor.

(emoji reactions: Chris :thumbsup:, Security :lock:, Infra-Oncall :white_check_mark:)
